AccountOut.description: What the backend keeps for an account. Name and email live with the identity provider.
AccountOut.title: AccountOut

AllowanceOut.description: The learner's voice minutes this week, in seconds (spec §6.19).
AllowanceOut.title: AllowanceOut

AnsweredOut.description:
A card answered out loud: what was heard, how close it came, and the rating that points
to. The card is not rated yet.
AnsweredOut.title: AnsweredOut

CallPlanOut.description:
What a practice conversation sets out to practise, as the learner sees it: the kinds of
mistake (a language pack's categories) and the words to use. How the partner is told to
bring them up stays on the server.
CallPlanOut.title: CallPlanOut

CardIn.description:
Which word or correction of a conversation's report to make a card of. The server reads
its content from the report; the app sends none.
CardIn.title: CardIn

CostsOut.description:
A month's estimated spending, for the owner (spec §6.19). Estimates from usage counts and
the configured prices, not the providers' invoices.
CostsOut.title: CostsOut

ExamCentreOut.description: The exam centre in one answer.
ExamCentreOut.title: ExamCentreOut

ExamPace.description: How often the week plans a simulation of the learner's speaking test.
ExamPace.title: ExamPace

ExamWeekOut.description: The week's simulations of the learner's speaking test.
ExamWeekOut.title: ExamWeekOut

GrammarTopicOut.description:
A topic of the grammar map and how well the learner has it. The app names it in the
interface language.
GrammarTopicOut.title: GrammarTopicOut

HomeOut.description: The Today screen in one answer.
HomeOut.title: HomeOut

LevelStepOut.description: The level the conversation's evidence moved the learner to (spec §6.9).
LevelStepOut.title: LevelStepOut

LookModel.description: A portrait's parts and colors. The app draws exactly these names.
LookModel.title: LookModel

MemoriesOut.description: What the learner's partners know about them, and what the learner set (spec §6.11).
MemoriesOut.title: MemoriesOut

MemoryPatch.description:
What to change about one memory. A key left out is not a change; `day: null` takes an
event's day away.
MemoryPatch.title: MemoryPatch

MemorySettingsPatch.description: A setting left out stays as it is.
MemorySettingsPatch.title: MemorySettingsPatch

PersonaDraftOut.description: A persona that is not saved: a template, or one written from a description.
PersonaDraftOut.title: PersonaDraftOut

PersonaIn.description: A new persona. Personality and teaching left out (or null): as their role does.
PersonaIn.title: PersonaIn

PersonaPatch.description:
The parts of a persona to change; the ones left out stay. Personality or teaching set
to null go back to what the persona's role does.
PersonaPatch.title: PersonaPatch

PersonalityModel.description: How a persona comes across. Each trait is a point from 1 to 5 between two poles.
PersonalityModel.title: PersonalityModel

PictureUploadOut.description: How to send a photo: a form POST to `url` with `fields`, then the JPEG as `file`.
PictureUploadOut.title: PictureUploadOut

ProgressOut.description: The Progress screen in one answer.
ProgressOut.title: ProgressOut

Reason.description: Why today's part of the plan is what it is.
Reason.title: Reason

RecordingIn.description: A sentence recorded on the device: a correction said again, or a card's answer.
RecordingIn.title: RecordingIn

ReminderNotesOut.description:
What the phone's reminders of the next seven days need besides the week's plan
(spec §6.18): the questions after the learner's events, and a word of the day.
ReminderNotesOut.title: ReminderNotesOut

SpeakingExamOut.description: A speaking test the exam centre simulates (spec §6.13).
SpeakingExamOut.title: SpeakingExamOut

TeachingModel.description:
How a persona treats mistakes and adapts to the learner. Every key is always present;
null means "as the learner's profile says" (or, for speed, the voice's own pace).
TeachingModel.title: TeachingModel

WeekPlanOut.description: This week's plan (the Learning Director, spec §6.12), as it stands now.
WeekPlanOut.title: WeekPlanOut

WeekReviewOut.description:
Last week's check-in (spec §6.12): its numbers, and a few sentences from the partner
once they are written.
WeekReviewOut.title: WeekReviewOut

WordDetailsOut.description: A word's forms (spec §6.7); a form the word does not have is null.
WordDetailsOut.title: WordDetailsOut

post.description:
Makes a flashcard of a word or a correction in a conversation's report. Saving one
that is a card already answers with that card.

get.description: One of the learner's cards (a word of the day opens it).

post.description:
Hears a card answered out loud (voice review) and says how close it came. The card
is rated as before, by the learner.

get.description:
Where the card's sound plays from: the word with its sentence, or a correction as it
is right, in the learner's partner's voice. Made the first time it is asked for.

post.description: Says correction `index` of a conversation's report again ("Say it better").

get.description: The corrections of a conversation's report the learner said again.

post.description:
Asks for a report that is not there: for an earlier conversation, or again after one
failed. Answers at once; the report is written in the background.

get.description: Where a part's model answer plays from, in the examiner's voice.

post.description: Asks again for a score that could not be written.

get.description: The cards of the learner's next simulation of a speaking test, to prepare with.
Every grammar topic of the language learned, with how well the learner has it.
One topic of the map, with the learner's own mistakes on it.
What the learner's partners know about them from earlier conversations.

patch.description: Turns memory on or off, or names the topics partners leave alone.

get.description: A month's estimated spending (this month unless `month` names its first day).
Whether the audio of the learner's conversations is kept (spec §6.6).

patch.description: Keeps recordings, or stops: stopping deletes every recording kept so far.

post.description: Asks the Tutor about one correction of a conversation's report (spec §6.5).

get.description: The questions the learner asked the Tutor, newest first.

post.description: Asks the Tutor a question about the language learned (spec §6.8).

get.description: Last week's check-in, to follow one being written; `week` is its Monday.

post.description: Has last week's check-in written (once); `week` is its Monday.

get.description: Where the check-in plays from, spoken by the partner who wrote it.
